title: Middle Eastern Warm Cheese Tagine
description: A rich and creamy Middle Eastern cheese tagine, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe combines warm spices with melted curds for a delightful twist on traditional cheese dishes.

ingredients.name: Gouda cheese
ingredients.notes: Dutch cheese with a mild flavor

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern cheese curds
ingredients.notes: Also known as paneer, these curds will melt beautifully in the tagine

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality butter for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Sweet or smoked paprika works well in this recipe

ingredients.name: Ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Warm and aromatic, cinnamon pairs perfectly with cheese

ingredients.name: Ground cumin
ingredients.notes: A classic Middle Eastern spice, cumin adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a few grinds of pepper to balance the flavors

instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the paprika, cinnamon, and cumin, and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the cheese curds and stir until they begin to melt.
Add the Gouda cheese and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Middle Eastern warm cheese tagine!
